punchline: At mile 70, with both feet fractured, Goggins did not look for a pep talk; he took Hell Week out of his jar.
thirty_sec: David Goggins's mother kept the cookie jar full even when money was short. He gave that name to his list of what he had got through, such as passing the Air Force exam and losing 106 pounds in three months. In a 24-hour race, at mile 70, feet fractured and badly dehydrated, he recalled Hell Week, felt his adrenaline take over and finished the hundred miles.
